newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-VLSI Technology FY97 cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-VLSI Technology FY97 cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Monday cut its estimate of VLSI Technology Inc's earnings for fiscal 1997 to $1.40 from $1.50 to reflect a somewhat higher tax rate.
-- Gruntal anslyst Mona Eraiba also projected earnings for fiscal 1998 at $1.75 and continued to recommend the purchase of VLSI shares.
-- Eraiba believes the stock is "extremely attractive" at current levels. She said the company has a valuable design library and many new programs that will be hitting volume in 1997 and 1998.
-- VLSI makes and markets application specific integrated circuits and design software tools.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/16 Monday at 17-7/16.
